COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red) are listed for p0/current/n0 and a separate origin/status line is given for the same current referent, showing content identification, organization/access metadata, and status distinction.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit coordinate listings identify content (red/blue) bound to named referents.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are given separately from origin/status metadata for the same referent, distinguishing identity from presentation/access status.

O.rationale: The report states how content is presented (grid orientation) and includes origin/representation metadata for current and candidate referents, i.e. organization/access information.
